interface.name: wp_cursor_shape_manager_v1
interface.description:
This global offers an alternative, optional way to set cursor images. This new way uses enumerated cursors instead of a wl_surface like wl_pointer.set_cursor does.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.

request.name: get_pointer

description.summary: manage the cursor shape of a pointer device

request.description:
Obtain a wp_cursor_shape_device_v1 for a wl_pointer object.
When the pointer capability is removed from the wl_seat, the wp_cursor_shape_device_v1 object becomes inert.

request.name: get_tablet_tool_v2

description.summary: manage the cursor shape of a tablet tool device

request.description:
Obtain a wp_cursor_shape_device_v1 for a zwp_tablet_tool_v2 object.
When the zwp_tablet_tool_v2 is removed, the wp_cursor_shape_device_v1 object becomes inert.

interface.name: wp_cursor_shape_device_v1
interface.description: This interface allows clients to set the cursor shape.

enum.name: shape
enum.description: This enum describes cursor shapes. The names are taken from the CSS cursor specification.

entry.name: invalid_shape
entry.summary: the specified shape value is invalid

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the cursor shape device. The device cursor shape remains unchanged.

request.name: set_shape

description.summary: set device cursor to the shape

request.description: Set the cursor to an enumerated shape. The serial must match the latest wl_pointer.enter or tablet proximity event sent to the client.
